title: Regulated Domain Schema
description: A regulated domain within a jurisdiction, such as banking or superannuation in Australia: the field an organization works in, grouping the entity types obligations are addressed to. Apps let a user choose a jurisdiction, then a domain, then the entity type, and use the domain to scope obligations and engagements. A domain describes who sources address, not which law binds a particular organization; that is for counsel.

regulatedDomainID.description: Unique identifier for the domain: the jurisdiction code and a short name, e.g. AU-BANKING

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction the domain belongs to, e.g. AU

name.description: Short name shown to users, e.g. Banking

description.description: What the domain covers, in plain words

financiallyRegulated.description: True when a prudential or financial services regulator licenses the entities in the domain. Apps use it to suggest a connected engagement; it is not a finding about any organization

regulators.description: Short names of the regulators most associated with the domain, for display

entityTypes.description: Entity types an organization in the domain chooses from

alsoReaches.description: Broader entity types whose sources also reach an organization in the domain, such as financialInstitution for every MAS-licensed domain. Records addressed to anyOrganization reach every domain and are not listed
